message:
release: 0.2.146 -- copy a file on one PC, paste it on the other

PC (Windows). Explorer Ctrl+C on the viewer's PC and Ctrl+V on the remote desktop (and the other way
round) carries the files over the session: GNLinkClipHelper.exe, a Medium-integrity helper, ships with
the product for the first time and holds the user's clipboard; offers, pins and the bulk transfer run
over the existing control and bulk channels (feat/file-copy-net, merged at its tip dacee8e).
Eleven review rounds fixed the session and helper-instance isolation: the session epoch owns the helper
channel and the bulk sender, a request takes only the answer of the helper it sent to, and a helper's
"gone" ends everything it owned. Known limit (P2): after the remote helper restarts within a session,
copy again on the source PC before pasting.

Integration: main = merge of dacee8e (tree = dacee8e + main's docs commit) + this version line.
Verifier's independent runs on the reviewed commits: build gate 29/0, net e2e 325/0 x2, helper e2e
100/0, clip-image e2e 34/0, negative controls failing exactly their counterexamples (r5..r11). Codex:
3b68b5f source OK, no blocking defect; dacee8e = one test probe line + tests.
Not verified: the field test itself (Explorer Ctrl+C -> Ctrl+V between two PCs); the helper is new in
this payload, so a fresh Setup install is the sure way to try it right away.

Product: version only. Test: none. Docs: none.
